requirements.description: Energy class D or better, as explicitly requested by the user. Covers all classes from A1 down to D. Gross floor area, capacity, and proximity to green spaces are not energy requirements and are excluded.

The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area, so this is a direct surface_area threshold. The 45-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided. Energy class, proximity to green spaces, and the Turin location are outside the reference columns and are handled by other agents.
User prefers properties near green spaces. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of green (74.26), rounded up to 75 so the value is not below the threshold.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività scolastiche' AND surface_area >= 600 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND green >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters school-type properties (property_type 'Attività scolastiche') with surface_area >= 600 sqm, within 3.0 km of the given coordinates, energy class A1–D, and green score >= 75. Results are ordered by haversine distance from the center point, nearest first. No extra filters were added beyond the extracted requirements.
